text:
We are looking for QA Engineers - Backend (Golang) Junior+ to join one of our teams — Cashback Partners .

 Challenges that await you:

• Analyzing requirements, creating test scenarios, preparing test data

• Developing and maintaining test documentation

• Acceptance and regression testing (automated and manual)

• Writing and maintaining automated tests in Go 

• Identifying, localizing, and reporting defects using a bug tracking system

• Communicating with the product team throughout development and participating in releases

• Maintaining the test project

 What makes you a great fit:

• 1–2 years of experience in QA

• A proactive, persistent, get-it-done attitude — you enjoy chasing a problem across teams until it’s actually solved, not just reported

• Experience developing and maintaining test documentation

• Programming experience in Go / Java / Python

• Experience with Git or other version control systems

• 
 B1 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team

 Your bonus skills:

• Hands-on experience in writing automated tests

• Experience with SQL

• Experience with AI tools in testing

 Our ways of working:

• 
 Innovative Spirit: A commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions

• 
 Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication

• 
 Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community

• 
 Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together

• 
 High-Tech Environment: a team full of smart and revolutionary people who date to challenge the status quo of incumbent finances

• 
 Team time zone: The team works within the GMT+1 to GMT+5 time zone

 Our benefits:

• 
 Relocation support to one of our hubs — Serbia or Georgia — with assistance for the employee and their family

• 
 Flexible work from one of our offices or remote

• Healthcare Coverage 

• 
 Education Budget: Language lessons, professional training and certifications

• 
 Wellness Budget: Mental health and fitness activity reimbursement

• 
 Vacation policy: 20 days of annual leave and paid sick leave
